answer: Ephemeral Challenge Commitments. Each identity must submit a fresh solution to a randomized challenge whose difficulty is seeded by the prior block's hash, forcing per-attempt computation rather than reusable work. The validator only accepts a solution if its input derives from a canyon of prior commitments, so copies fail validation. Each attempt also yields a nectar token consumed by verification, and a failed submission leaves a plume trace in the audit log tying the attempt to real compute.
